_comment: An index of the domain extensions kept in this repo. Informational only: nothing loads it at runtime. The engine finds domains through the 'rag.domains' entry point, so a domain installed from outside this repo works identically and simply will not appear here. tests/test_domains.py keeps this file honest against the directories and their declarations.

domains.name: rag-domain-cardiovascular
domains.job: Research the cardiac, vascular and autonomic literature by its own evidence hierarchy.

domains.name: rag-domain-respiratory
domains.job: Research breathing, gas exchange and the chemoreflex by this field's own endpoints.

domains.name: rag-domain-vestibular
domains.job: Research balance and dizziness by a diagnostic-accuracy evidence hierarchy, not a trial one.

domains.name: rag-domain-neuroscience
domains.job: Research the nervous system with the species gap and reverse inference treated as first-class failure modes.
